## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### Through an API

api (Xiaomi MiMo) · $0.18/M blended · $0.14 in / $0.28 out per 1M tokens · [mimo.mi.com](https://mimo.mi.com/docs/en-US/quick-start/summary/model)

<sub>[price source](https://mimo.mi.com/docs/en-US/price/pay-as-you-go): Xiaomi MiMo API Pricing (pay-as-you-go), 'Overseas Pricing of the Model', Language Models, Real-time API row 'mimo-v2.6-flash': Input (Cache Hit) $0.0028, Input (Cache Miss) $0.14, Output $0.28 per M tokens (USD); cache-miss input and output used; batch API ($0.07/$0.14) and China RMB prices excluded. Observed 2026-10-09. · [context source](https://huggingface.co/XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL/blob/5711b268169967567844e1e560e8a3966da959b1/README.md): Official model card 'Model Summary': 'Context Length: 1M tokens'; Xiaomi API model page lists mimo-v2.6-flash 'Context Window: 1M', 'Maximum Output: 128K'. Observed 2026-10-09.</sub>

### llama.cpp (recommended)

1. Install llama.cpp. Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead. [Other ways to install](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md)
   
   ```sh
   # macOS / Linux
   curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh
   # Windows
   irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

2. Run MiMo-V2.6-Flash (309B-A15B) (Q2_K, needs ~127.77 GB, from [huggingface.co/ggml-org](https://huggingface.co/ggml-org/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL-GGUF/tree/a5d1269fdcf9c3346934411f700038e9cd9d5102))
   
   ```sh
   llama cli -hf ggml-org/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL-GGUF:Q2_K
   ```

3. Or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
   
   ```sh
   llama serve -hf ggml-org/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL-GGUF:Q2_K
   ```

Other versions: mxfp4 (~170.12 GB) `llama cli -hf ggml-org/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL-GGUF:MXFP4`

### LM Studio

1. Install LM Studio. Open the app once before using the lms command. [Download it (macOS / Windows / Linux)](https://lmstudio.ai/download)

2. Run MiMo-V2.6-Flash (309B-A15B) (Q2_K, needs ~127.77 GB, from [huggingface.co/ggml-org](https://huggingface.co/ggml-org/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL-GGUF/tree/a5d1269fdcf9c3346934411f700038e9cd9d5102))
   
   ```sh
   lms get https://huggingface.co/ggml-org/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL-GGUF@Q2_K -y
   ```

3. Then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name

Other versions: mxfp4 (~170.12 GB) `lms get https://huggingface.co/ggml-org/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL-GGUF@MXFP4 -y`
